entries.en: Hey, V, I heard some soldier just opened fire on pedestrians at the pier.
entries.ro: Hei, V, am auzit că un soldat tocmai a tras în pietoni pe chei.

entries.en: If you can swing it, I want him stopped, but not killed. Then I'll send the right people for him.
entries.ro: Dacă te descurci, vreau să-l oprești, dar nu să-l omori. Apoi trimit eu oamenii potriviți după el.

entries.en: More details are on the way.
